snippet.description:
안녕하세요!

오늘은 농심의 편의점 3사 컵라면 신제품!

snippet.description:
안녕하세요!
오늘은 농심에서 출시한 신라면 김치볶음면을리뷰했습니다.
신라면의 매콤함에 볶음김치의 고소함이라니…
김치랑청경채후레이크가 제법 존재감 있고, 면발이 소스에 촥촥!

솔직히 이건 한 번쯤 먹어봐야겠죠?

맛있게 시청하세요!!

Hello!
Today I reviewed Nongshim’s new SHIN RAMYUN KIMCHI STIR FRY.
Spicy SHIN RAMYUN meets the savory punch of stir-fried kimchi… what a combo.

The kimchi and bok choy flakes actually have a solid presence, and the noodles soak up the sauce perfectly!
Honestly, this is something you have to try at least once, right?

Enjoy watching!

en-US.title: Convenience store cup ramen that has awakened
en-US.description:
Hello!

Today, we're reviewing Nongshim's new cup ramen products from three convenience store chains!
I reviewed 7-Eleven's Gamjatang Big Bowl Noodles, CU's Bubbling Budae Jjigae Big Bowl Noodles, and GS25's Gamjamyeon Spicy Big Bowl Noodles.

Each has a different flavor profile, but the broth is rich and the ingredients are plentiful. Honestly, I found all three to be delicious.

This combination... I definitely have to try it at least once, right? Haha

Enjoy watching!!

#Advertisement 
Hello! This is Eat or Not.
I reviewed the spicy ramen released by Ottogi! 'Ramen's Spicy Soddy'.
The broth is refreshing and clean, but the spiciness comes up late.
It is not a spicy taste that tingles your tongue, but a clean spiciness that differentiates it from existing spicy ramen.
If you like spicy food, try it!!
